name: MIMIC-IV benchmark
description: Electronic health record (EHR) is more and more popular, and it comes with applying machine learning solutions to resolve various problems in the domain. This growing research area also raises the need for EHRs accessibility. Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care (MIMIC) dataset is a popular, public, and free EHR dataset in a raw format that has been used in numerous studies. However, despite of its popularity, it is lacking benchmarking work, especially with recent state of the art works in the field of deep learning with time-series tabular data. The aim of this work is to fill this lack by providing a benchmark for latest version of MIMIC dataset, MIMIC-IV. We also give a detailed literature survey about studies that has been already done for MIIMIC-III.
reputation: Widely used clinical EHR benchmark with broad adoption in medical ML research and many published baselines.
notes: Requires credentialed access and data use agreement; contains sensitive health data; results affected by class imbalance and dataset shift; potential overlap/contamination with models trained on public MIMIC subsets.
